title: Seaside Cottage Near Beach Access Sleeps 6
meta_description: 2BR Seaside cottage for 6 with two king suites, outdoor living, a private yard, and a short walk to the beach and East Ruskin Pavilion.
description_expanded: Blue Suede Shoes, Seaside Florida Vacation Rental Just 6 Homes from the BeachDiscover the perfect blend of location, comfort, and coastal charm at Blue Suede Shoes, a beautifully renovated Seaside, Florida vacation rental located just six homes from the beach and one block from the iconic Seaside Amphitheater. This charming home places guests within easy walking distance of Seaside's renowned restaurants, boutique shopping, food trucks, and community events, making it an ideal destination for families, couples, and 30A beach vacations.Renovated Seaside Cottage With Two King Primary SuitesRecently renovated throughout, the home features two king primary suites, each with a private ensuite bath, offering exceptional comfort and privacy for multiple couples or families traveling together. The open-concept living area is designed for gathering, while the updated kitchen showcases quartz countertops, Bosch stainless steel appliances, a farmhouse sink, and inviting spaces for entertaining and everyday living.Outdoor living is a highlight of the Blue Suede Shoes experience. The welcoming front porch overlooks a private fenced yard, while the outdoor dining area provides the perfect setting for al fresco meals beneath the Florida sunshine. Whether enjoying fresh Gulf seafood after a beach day or relaxing with evening cocktails, guests will appreciate the home's seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living.The main-level king suite offers a private screened porch and renovated bath, creating a peaceful retreat after a day along the Emerald Coast. Upstairs, the second king primary suite features a spacious spa-inspired bath with dual vanities and dual rain shower heads. An open loft with a king sleeper sofa provides additional flexibility for families and guests.After spending the day on Seaside's sugar-white beaches, return home to rinse off in the private enclosed outdoor shower before gathering around the grill for dinner under the stars. Every detail of Blue Suede Shoes has been thoughtfully designed to deliver the quintessential Seaside beach vacation experience.For travelers searching for a Seaside Florida rental near the beach, a 30A vacation home with two king suites, or a renovated home within walking distance of town, Blue Suede Shoes offers one of the most desirable locations in Seaside. From morning walks to the Gulf to evenings spent enjoying the vibrant town center, this coastal retreat provides everything needed for an unforgettable stay along Scenic Highway 30A.* Please be advised that some exterior areas of this home are under video surveillance.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURESFeatures 1,605 square feet1-minute walk, 460 feet to beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion; largest private beach on 30AOutdoor diningEnclosed outdoor showerCharcoal grillLaundry Room w/full size washer and dryerAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts (ct. fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided.2 parking passes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car, and for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002178
